description: Email continue_url (/s/{id}) to the verified account inbox. Requires OAuth trips scope. Rate-limited. Not a booking; you can share continue_url without emailing.

email.description: Optional. Must match the verified OAuth account email if sent. The link is always sent to that account.

firstName.description: Optional salutation for the email body.

lastName.description: Optional salutation for the email body.

locale.description: Response language and site context. One of en, nl, da, sv.

name: email_trip

emailed_to.description: Verified account inbox that received the email.
